definition: Unique identifier for the posting within this study.
allowed_values_or_format: Industry prefix and a sequence number, for example HC-01.

definition: Which of the three selected industries the employer sits in.
allowed_values_or_format: One of the three approved industry labels.

definition: Where the posting was found.
Direct link to the posting.
The date the posting text was captured.
The kind of organization, not its name.
allowed_values_or_format: For example: public sector, large private, small private, nonprofit.

definition: The posting's own title, verbatim.
In the coder's words, what this role exists to fix or produce.
What the person would decide, as opposed to perform. Where the posting does not say, record NOT STATED.
The main duties, condensed but not reinterpreted.
Industry or subject knowledge the posting assumes, verbatim where possible, then classified.
allowed_values_or_format: Verbatim text plus readable, observable or gated.

definition: Named systems, platforms or software.
Qualifications or certifications named.
allowed_values_or_format: Verbatim, plus issuing body if named, or NOT STATED.

definition: Registration or license named, and whether the posting presents it as legally required.
allowed_values_or_format: Verbatim, plus required, preferred, or NOT DETERMINABLE FROM POSTING.

definition: Stated quantity or type of prior experience.
allowed_values_or_format: Verbatim figure or range, or NOT STATED.

definition: Who the role works across: teams, functions, external parties, seniority of the people involved.
What the person is answerable for if it goes wrong.
What the posting says the person may decide without approval.
On site, hybrid, remote, or not stated.
Industry-specific words used for activities that exist elsewhere under other names. This field feeds the central comparison.
allowed_values_or_format: List of terms with the plain-language equivalent.

definition: Each stated requirement assigned to exactly one category.
allowed_values_or_format: CAPABILITY, DOMAIN, CREDENTIAL, TOOL or EXPERIENCE.

definition: How each requirement is framed by the posting.
allowed_values_or_format: HARD, PREFERRED or AMBIGUOUS, per requirement.

definition: For any requirement that looks shared with another industry: what the person has to decide, and what happens if they decide it badly.
allowed_values_or_format: Free text. Feeds the real-overlap versus apparent-overlap count.

definition: Ambiguities, judgment calls, and anything a second reader should check.
